# weapp.dev

> weapp.dev hosts tools for real mini-app repos: weapp-tailwindcss for styles, weapp-vite for builds, and Varo for Registry-first component delivery. You can adopt the released tools separately.

## Official project pages

- [weapp-tailwindcss](https://weapp.dev/projects/weapp-tailwindcss/): Tailwind CSS v4 generation, class transforms, and platform-aware styling for mini-apps and cross-platform frameworks.
- [weapp-vite](https://weapp.dev/projects/weapp-vite/): Vite-powered development, builds, runtime tooling, and multi-platform output for mini-app projects.
- [Varo](https://weapp.dev/projects/varo/): Registry-first editable component source, primitives, business Blocks, and Agent UI for H5 and Wevu mini-programs.
- [VPT](https://weapp.dev/projects/vite-plugin-taro/): Vite 8, React 19, and Taro 4 for WeChat, Alipay, and Web apps, with state-preserving hot reload, automatic WeChat subpackages, and Tailwind CSS v4.
- [Vue Mini](https://weapp.dev/projects/vue-mini/): Vue 3 reactivity and Composition API for WeChat mini programs; docs at vuemini.org.
- [Rezor](https://weapp.dev/projects/rezor/): React Hooks mini-program framework; docs currently point at the GitHub repository.
- [Uni Helper](https://weapp.dev/projects/uni-helper/): uni-app org tooling portal; installable entry is create-uni.
- [Wot UI](https://weapp.dev/projects/wot-ui/): uni-app Vue 3 component library published as wot-design-uni.
- [English project index](https://weapp.dev/en/): English overview of the stack.
- [Sponsorship and services](https://weapp.dev/pricing/): One-time sponsorship tiers with a 60/25/15 public split, plus scoped migration and training services.
- [Contributor program](https://weapp.dev/contributors/): Quarterly sharing of confirmed sponsorship with eligible contributors.

## Open-source sponsorship

- One-time tiers: ¥20 supporter, ¥200 Bronze, and ¥1,000 Silver.
- ¥200 and above may receive public GitHub link recognition after identity confirmation, maintainer review, and explicit authorization.
- Approved public recognition can be synchronized across weapp.dev, tw.weapp.dev, and vite.weapp.dev.
- Confirmed sponsorship is split 60% core maintenance, 25% contributors fund, and 15% nearby open source; destinations are announced quarterly.
- Sponsorship is not a purchase of technical support, templates, cloud-build minutes, or subscription access.
